framework: Nishpaksh Samaj / Shamikaran Yatharth Siddhant / Yatharth Yug

records.claim: The canonical Yatharth/Shirmani source is published under the repository author account and can be checked against repository history and hashes.
User-supplied photographs, eyes/face images, voice or conversation material may be attached as provenance material when explicitly supplied by the user.
records.limitation: Media consistency must not be converted into biometric identity inference.

records.claim: A person saying “मैं शिरोमणि हूँ” is an identity claim that requires independent provenance review and must not be auto-verified.
